name: Cancun
dek: Caribbean coast climate from the Cancún station, plus the country practical facts.
paragraphs: The station is Cancún, clave 23155, in Benito Juárez, 9 metres above the sea. It is the coast, not Mérida and not the inland peninsula. The National Hurricane Center's Atlantic season, 1 June through 30 November, covers the wetter half of the year on this shore.

The normal stays hot in every month. What changes is the rain. Use the strip to see the drier months and the heavy ones, and treat a monthly total as an average, not a promise about a particular week. The entry link is the immigration institute's page. This sheet does not rewrite it.

climate.caption: Station: Cancún (23155), Benito Juárez, Quintana Roo, 9 m.
climate.note: Servicio Meteorológico Nacional normal, issued 06/11/2026. Years with data for the maximum-temperature normal: 28 to 29, depending on the month.

season: The National Hurricane Center says the Atlantic hurricane season runs from 1 June to 30 November.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type A and B, 127 V, 60 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list shows Mexico at 127 volts and 60 hertz, with plug type A and B.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Article 109 of the federal highway regulation, as published in the Diario Oficial on 22 November 2012, says vehicles are to be driven in the right-hand lane of a federal highway, except when overtaking, when the road is too narrow for two lanes, when the right side is blocked, on the three-lane case the article describes, or on a one-way road. This is the federal highway rule, not a city bylaw.
driving.sourceTitle: Diario Oficial de la Federación, 22 November 2012, Reglamento de Tránsito, Article 109

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.detail: Mexico's consumer protection agency, Profeco, says tipping is voluntary. No establishment can require it or add it without telling you first. Profeco does not publish a customary percentage, so this page does not invent one.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Mexico, last reviewed 3 September 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards vary by destination and by what you are doing, and it points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Mexican Peso and the code MXN for Mexico.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: Quintana Roo is the Sureste zone in the time-zone law, tied to the meridian 75° west. IANA names that area America/Cancun and the zone1970.tab comment says Quintana Roo.

sources.sourceTitle: Ley de los Husos Horarios, artículo 3 fracción IV

entry.note: This is the Mexican government's page on who must apply for a visa. We do not copy that list.

bestTime.intro: Month by month for Cancún, from the station 23155 table above (1991–2020, 9 m) and the U.S. National Hurricane Center's Atlantic season window. Every month in the table is warm: the average high never drops below 28.7 °C, so the months turn on rain, heat and the hurricane season rather than on temperature. The rule line is our month-list test, not a recommendation, and the hurricane dates are official season dates, not a forecast; NHC says activity sometimes occurs before and after them.

months.note: Average high 28.7 °C, low 20 °C, 103.8 mm. The lowest average high and the lowest average low in the Cancún table. Fails our month-list rule on precipitation (100 mm or more). Outside the Atlantic hurricane season (1 June to 30 November).
Average high 30.1 °C, low 20.6 °C, 59.3 mm. Fails our month-list rule on heat: the average high is above 30 °C. Outside the Atlantic hurricane season (1 June to 30 November).

Average high 31.5 °C, low 21.4 °C, 38.7 mm. The driest month in the Cancún table. Fails our month-list rule on heat: the average high is above 30 °C. Outside the Atlantic hurricane season (1 June to 30 November).
Average high 33.1 °C, low 22.9 °C, 42.3 mm. Fails our month-list rule on heat: the average high is above 30 °C. Outside the Atlantic hurricane season (1 June to 30 November).
Average high 34.2 °C, low 24.2 °C, 87 mm. Fails our month-list rule on heat: the average high is above 30 °C. Outside the Atlantic hurricane season (1 June to 30 November).

Average high 34 °C, low 24.9 °C, 184.4 mm. Fails our month-list rule on both heat (above 30 °C) and precipitation (100 mm or more). The Atlantic hurricane season opens on 1 June. NHC says the first named storm typically forms in mid to late June.

Average high 34.8 °C, low 25 °C, 67 mm. Tied for the highest average low in the Cancún table. Fails our month-list rule on heat: the average high is above 30 °C. Inside the Atlantic hurricane season (1 June to 30 November).

Average high 35.1 °C, low 25 °C, 102.2 mm. The highest average high and tied for the highest average low in the Cancún table. Fails our month-list rule on both heat (above 30 °C) and precipitation (100 mm or more). Inside the Atlantic hurricane season. NHC says most Atlantic activity falls between mid-August and mid-October, and the first hurricane tends to form in early to mid-August.

Average high 34.2 °C, low 24.6 °C, 181.5 mm. Fails our month-list rule on both heat (above 30 °C) and precipitation (100 mm or more). Inside the Atlantic hurricane season. NHC puts the peak of the season at 10 September.

Average high 32.2 °C, low 23.7 °C, 277.1 mm. The wettest month in the Cancún table. Fails our month-list rule on both heat (above 30 °C) and precipitation (100 mm or more). Inside the Atlantic hurricane season; NHC's mid-August to mid-October main window runs into this month.
Average high 30.3 °C, low 22.3 °C, 131.4 mm. Fails our month-list rule on both heat (above 30 °C) and precipitation (100 mm or more). The Atlantic hurricane season ends on 30 November.
Average high 29.4 °C, low 21 °C, 96.6 mm. Passes our month-list rule (average high 20–30 °C, under 100 mm). Outside the Atlantic hurricane season (1 June to 30 November).
